composition_subtypes.role: Sort tickets descending to assign largest prices to most valuable positions
Binary search over m to find minimal tickets needed

payload.composition_order: 1. Sort tickets descending; 2. Binary search over m using greedy donation check f(m).
payload.core_composition_summary: Sort tickets descending, then binary search minimum m with greedy assignment of largest prices to positions with highest donation rates.
payload.rationale: The solution uses sorting to enable a greedy assignment and binary search to optimize m. These are distinct mechanisms coordinated to achieve the goal.
